finding.libmtmd_lifetime: Current libmtmd aggregates encoded media features inside mtmd_batch.output_embd. The server keeps an mtmd batch object while processing the media chunk and can pass the encoded output to the decode path. This supports a synchronous feature tap before decode without a second vision encode. It does not by itself establish safe cross-request ownership of a raw float pointer.
finding.active_perception: Current GUI research supports adaptive crop/zoom and staged coarse-to-fine perception, but recent uncertainty-quantification evidence shows calibration/ranking does not transfer reliably across model classes and observable interfaces. Frank therefore needs target-model/runtime calibration rather than generic confidence thresholds.
finding.memory_failure: Full-image visual memory can reduce some state errors while worsening hidden-operation blindness and grounding. Action-grounded local evidence is a stronger candidate, but local evidence alone creates a global-coverage failure mode.
finding.fusion: Retina should remain temporal/provenance/control fabric. Add a bounded Perceptual Budget Controller that jointly uses current visual uncertainty, task/action criticality, visual alias conflict, change topology and explicit global coverage debt to decide NONE/ROI_PLUS_CONTEXT/COARSE_GLOBAL/ZOOM/FULL. Add a Versioned Visual Evidence Cache for owned descriptors and exact provenance, never for truth or effect authority.

perceptual_budget_controller.coverage_debt_law: Every region or semantic surface not freshly observed accumulates bounded coverage debt. High debt, high action risk, detected topology change, alias conflict or memory contradiction can force a wider observation even when the local ROI is confident.
perceptual_budget_controller.calibration_law: Uncertainty thresholds are calibrated and revalidated on the exact target model/runtime/interface regime; verbal confidence or a threshold imported from another model is insufficient.

versioned_visual_evidence_cache.synchronous_tap: A raw libmtmd embedding view may be consumed synchronously while the owning batch lifetime is valid. Any longer-lived use must copy/derive into an owned bounded descriptor with version/provenance identity.

strongest_counterhypotheses: A fixed hybrid periodic-anchor policy is simpler and Pareto-superior; PBC control overhead and extra sensing erase token/latency savings.
Model-calibrated uncertainty remains confidently wrong under GUI distribution shift, so coverage debt cannot make selective perception safe enough.
Native llama.cpp multimodal/KV caching already provides equivalent reusable representations, making a Frank-owned descriptor cache redundant.
Cross-request descriptor reuse creates more stale-state/alias errors than compute savings, so only within-request feature tapping should survive.
falsifiers: Equal-budget GUI replay shows PBC-VEC-1 does not reduce visual tokens or decoder calls while preserving task success, hidden-operation detection and grounding versus FULL_FRAME and HYBRID_PERIODIC_ANCHOR.
Wrong-confidence and interface-shift fixtures show coverage debt fails to force wider sensing before consequential errors.
Exact target runtime demonstrates safe native cross-request media-feature reuse with version identity and no re-encode, removing the need for VEC.
VEC stale/version-swap controls produce any silent reuse rather than a cache miss/quarantine.
unresolved_uncertainty: No target-VPS PBC/VEC runtime measurement exists yet; no architecture promotion is justified.
